name: agent:ready
description: Queued for the 24/7 agent runtime to pick up

name: agent:in-progress
description: Claimed by the agent runtime; do not start another

name: agent:blocked
description: Agent stopped; missing info or external dependency

name: agent:needs-human
description: Requires human decision, review or merge

name: risk:low
description: Small, reversible, well-tested change; eligible for auto-merge

name: risk:medium
description: New business logic or multiple modules; human review

name: risk:high
description: Security, migrations, deps, infra/CI, secrets or baselines; human required
